chunks: They were commanded only to serve God with all-exclusive faith in Him, to be upright, and to fulfil their devotional obligations, and to give zakat; for this is the even way.

key_terms.الدِّينَ: The religion or way of life
key_terms.حُنَفَاءَ: Upright monotheists following the pure faith of Abraham
key_terms.مُخْلِصِينَ: Exclusively dedicating worship to God alone

ai.seo_question: What are the four main obligations commanded in Surah Al-Bayyinah verse 5?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often viewed as the culmination of divine guidance, where the specific command to worship God exclusively (Tawhid) is intrinsically linked to the practical pillars of Salat and Zakat, establishing the 'straight religion' as both a theological and social framework. The term 'Hunafa' is interpreted not merely as monotheists but as those following the pure, uncorrupted nature (Fitrah) of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), distinguishing the true path from the deviations of the People of the Book. This verse thus serves as a definitive criterion for the 'straight religion' that aligns with the Shia understanding of Imamate and divine justice. [{
